scripts.openapi:generate: npx openapi-typescript openapi/upstream/v0.yaml --output packages/bangumi-openapi/src/generated/schema.ts && ts-node scripts/generate-openapi-client.ts && ts-node scripts/generate-operation-registry.ts && ts-node scripts/calculate-coverage.ts && pnpm build && ts-node scripts/generate-tool-catalog.ts && prettier --write "packages/bangumi-openapi/src/generated/**/*.{ts,json}" "packages/bangumi-openapi/src/operation-registry.ts" "openapi/generated-operation-registry.json" "docs/api-coverage.md" "docs/tool-catalog.json"
scripts.openapi:verify: pnpm openapi:validate && pnpm openapi:generate && git diff --exit-code packages/bangumi-openapi/src/generated openapi/generated-operation-registry.json packages/bangumi-openapi/src/operation-registry.ts docs/api-coverage.md docs/tool-catalog.json
scripts.test:host: cd examples/nonebot2-claude-code && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v
